Exact in-memory execution of the committed functions classified a mixed `do not directly read or write ...; echo > docs/story/...` instruction as policy-reminder and `Use apply_patch to update docs/story/...` as other/grandfathered; simulating a refreshed baseline left verifyFindings plus verifyNoUnregisteredDirectStoryWrite with zero failures for both. Thus --write can bless actionable story-file writes despite CHK-005. Check direct-write signals before negative reminders, fail closed on unrecognized mutation forms, and add mixed-policy/apply_patch/copy/multiline probes.

Direct-write detection now precedes harmless-policy classification at the clause level, covers apply_patch plus Edit/Write/tee/sed/redirection/cp/copy/mv/move/install/rsync and backslash continuations, fails closed on unknown actionable forms, and `--write` rejects every recognized unapproved write. Role-wide grandfathering was replaced by one exact current INIT echo allow entry. findings.desc: quality-correctness: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:1392 treats any verbatim prompt substring as support for any matrix claim, while the :1830 mutation probe deliberately leaves the claim ledger unchanged, so it proves only that an unmapped claim fails. Exact in-memory execution of the committed buildRoleMatrixEvidence accepted adding `scope_check_save` to lattice-review-behavior commands when the ledger paired it with the mention-only snippet `Default inputs: the lattice scope_check_save result recorded by lattice-review-scope-plan`; that text describes an input, not permission to call the writer. The committed matrix at docs/requirements/baselines/proof-or-stop-prompt-overlap-matrix.md:13 is also non-exhaustive: the canonical behavior prompt requires git diff, session_brief/aux_doc_list/story_get, and dev_memory preflight/search, but lists only checklist_get plus review writes, even though other rows count git diff and common reads. Therefore the emitted `exhaustive role matrix source claims verified` result is unsupported and false ownership can survive a refreshed baseline. Ground command claims in a structured allowed-command source, check prompt-to-matrix completeness, and add a mutation that updates the ledger with a misleading mention but must still fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ce499e68b0. Removed the substring-based `exhaustive role matrix source claims verified` machinery and its misleading mutation probe. The baseline now states an explicit audit boundary: machine checks exact 16 role snapshots, template/agent_prompt hashes, required non-empty fields, JSON/Markdown parity, and drift; commands/directFileAccess/outputs remain a human reviewer-audited snapshot and are not claimed as parser-proven ownership. The matrix was manually re-audited, including behavior command ownership. Evidence: normal verifier prints the reviewer-audited semantic boundary and snapshot-drift probe rejects JSON plus Markdown drift.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: The artifact table labels ledgerHash, planHash, and rollupHash as current code-backed freshness/anti-forgery bindings, and the closeout contract says existing gates validate artifact hashes, but the ProofStory readers never recompute any of those hashes. computeMilestoneLedgerHash, computeSlicePlanHash, and computeParentLedgerRollupHash are writer-only; parentRollupCoversSlicePlan checks only stored cross-field equality, coverage, and evidenceRefs. A read-only HEAD probe passed evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence(..., enforce) with arbitrary mutually matching ledgerHash/planHash/rollupHash values and with a forged rollupHash alone (status=pass, blocking=false, gaps=[]). Amend M4.C1 and the current-contract wording to require reader/gate recomputation or content-bound canonical-writer provenance before these fields are described as integrity bindings.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ce499e68b0. The execution plan now states that writers compute ledgerHash/planHash/rollupHash but current readers and DONE do not recompute them; `parentRollupCoversSlicePlan` does not consume rollupHash. It labels matching stored fields as consistency checks, not anti-forgery proof, and requires M4.C1 runtime schema validation and hash recomputation before these artifacts become trust/review-retention boundaries.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: The new overlap matrix is not a complete command inventory even though M0.3 says it covers commands. The lattice-review-delivery row lists only delivery_check_set, while its canonical prompt requires two explicit git diff main...HEAD commands; lattice-review-behavior likewise relies on git diff but omits it, whereas the docs/concept/quality rows do classify git diff/grep as commands. The verifier only proves that each listed claim has a supporting snippet and its mutation probe only rejects unsupported additions, so it passes while source commands are omitted. Add the missing commands or define a consistent narrower Commands contract and mechanically check prompt-to-matrix completeness.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ce499e68b0. Added `git diff` to both lattice-review-behavior and lattice-review-delivery command snapshots. The plan/matrix now define Commands as a manually audited semantic snapshot, while automation only locks the chosen snapshot and parity; it no longer claims prompt-to-matrix completeness. Evidence: all 16 rows have required fields and the verifier's JSON/Markdown snapshot-drift probe passes.
